const { setTimeout } = require("timers/promises");

export async function waitForRetry(delay) {
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout();
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(0);
  // ruleid: next-frame-call-javascript
  await setTimeout(16);
  await setTimeout(17);
  await setTimeout(200);
  await setTimeout(delay);
}
